comment: Holds information about a single segment of slow motion playback within a track.

variables.name: startTimeMs
variables.comment: The start time, in milliseconds, of the track segment that is intended to be slow motion.

variables.name: endTimeMs
variables.comment: The end time, in milliseconds, of the track segment that is intended to be slow motion.

variables.name: speedDivisor
variables.comment:
* The speed reduction factor. * *

For example, 4 would mean the segment should be played at a quarter (1/4) of the normal * speed.
